title: AXI Different-ID Read Completion
description: Read A (ID 0) is accepted before Read B (ID 1), but B's two-beat response completes first; RID keeps both completions attributable.

annotations.message: Read A is accepted first with ID 0.
Read B is accepted next with ID 1. Different IDs create independent response-order streams.
The target returns B first with RID 1. This is permitted; different IDs have no relative response-order guarantee.
B completes with RLAST=1 while A remains outstanding.
A begins later with RID 0, allowing the master to select A's scoreboard entry.
A completes. Out-of-order completion improved service opportunity without changing beat order within either burst.
